subject.title: [Feature]: Persist interruption context for the next turn after an aborted run

question: Should a model-visible aborted-turn warning become a canonical transcript invariant for every OpenClaw agent harness?
rationale: This introduces durable core transcript semantics and changes all providers' next-turn context after interruption, so maintainers must confirm the cross-harness contract and wording rather than inheriting Codex-specific behavior implicitly.

options.title: Adopt canonical marker
options.body: Add one harness-neutral hidden marker in agent-core and require every aborted run to expose it to the next model turn.

options.title: Keep harness-specific
options.body: Let each harness decide whether and how to inject interruption context, accepting behavioral differences between runtimes.

options.title: Retain current behavior
options.body: Continue recording only the aborted assistant message without additional next-turn guidance.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical marker
recommendation.body: Add one harness-neutral hidden marker in agent-core and require every aborted run to expose it to the next model turn.

likelyOwner.reason: The current agent-core and transcript ownership boundary was established through their recent runtime internalization work.
